prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 25.3% higher than a year ago. Also in its favour: over the past year the share did 27.5 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; the share price is close to its 52-week high; and value scores 66 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: what the price asks for the earnings, growth, the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: return on capital employed is only 1.2%, a weak return on the money in the business. Also against it: net debt is 4.4 times a year of operating earnings, heavy; operating profit covers interest only 0.5 times, thin; and the 3-year maximum drawdown was -54.6%, a deep fall. Other areas on this side: price behaviour, the quality of the business, risk.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 6 points in favour and 9 against give more points against. The pool score is 29 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet. That gives an educational rating of Underweight with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
